turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hey, how's your day been so far?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm retired now and finally have time to learn to cook properly. Where should I start?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Congratulations! I'd start with knife skills and a few basics, like a good omelette, a simple soup and a roast.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Right, next thing. I'm planning a photo walk this weekend and can't pick where to go.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hear me out on all the options before you comment.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: One option is the old downtown market early in the morning, when vendors are setting up.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Another is the botanical garden, which has a big flower show going on right now.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or there's the harbor at sunset, with the boats and the bridge lit up.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: The harbor at sunset will give you the most dramatic light, especially with the bridge. The market is great for candid shots and street photography. The flower show is perfect for practicing close ups and color.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: How long do these potatoes need, Nova?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Knife skills, really? I've been chopping onions for forty years, Moshi.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Then you're ahead already. Still, learning to dice quickly and safely makes every recipe more fun.
